description: This file defines the interface for the ChargeDropdownReadPlatformService, which provides methods to retrieve various types of enumeration data related to charges, loans, savings, clients, and shares within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ChargeDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to retrieve dropdown options for charge-related configurations and types.

methods.name: retrieveCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of calculation type options.

methods.name: retrieveApplicableToTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of applicable-to types.

methods.name: retrieveCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of collection time types.

methods.name: retrivePaymentModes
methods.description: Returns a list of payment mode options.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of loan calculation types.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of loan collection time types.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of savings calculation types.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of savings collection time types.

methods.name: retrieveClientCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of client calculation types.

methods.name: retrieveClientCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of client collection time types.

methods.name: retrieveSharesCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of share calculation types.

methods.name: retrieveSharesCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of share collection time types.
